svg.title: Resource-domain trust and execution architecture for AI agent revocation
svg.desc: Independent authority sources and status publishers feed a domain-local trust service. An untrusted proposer has no direct effect access. A protected controller, resource-side gate, effect adapter and persistent operation ledger govern exact candidates, scope, expiry and terminal receipts at each resource boundary without assuming one global trust root. Source: Dr. Carsten Stöcker / Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
